{{Wireless adapter |brand=Panasonic |model=DY-WL10 |revision= |upc=885170002272 |ean= |asin=B003960G1U |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=12/13/2009 |manuf_country=Japan |manuf=Murata |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=dongle |vendor_id=04da |device_id=1800 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=ACJ-DY-WL10 |ic_id=216A-DYWL10 |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM4323 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=00:26:E8,5C:DA:D4 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "MCL-E-67" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
Used with some Panasonic HDTVs and Blu-ray players. Many report the device as interchangeable with the [[Netgear WNDA3100 v2]].
The device has two internal U.FL connectors. Assumed to use the BCM4323.
